source_event.summary: Independent audit found a business-initiated provider message using a payload mode valid only inside a transient user service window.

generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A system-initiated message is sent with a free-form payload mode that is valid only during a transient user interaction window, while the provider requires a pre-approved template outside that window.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Treat successful fake-provider HTTP acceptance of a free-form payload as proof that a proactive notification is provider-eligible in every temporal messaging context.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: When a provider distinguishes session messages from proactive messages, use the provider-approved proactive payload mode for system-initiated delivery and fail safe when the required template reference is absent or invalid; never silently fall back to session-only free-form content.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Exercise a configured proactive send and assert one provider outbound with the approved template reference and no free-form body, then remove and malform the template reference and assert canonical degradation with zero provider outbound.

transfer_cases.scenario: proactive reminder requires approved template reference and no free-form fallback
proactive renewal notice degrades safely when approved template reference is missing

skill_changes.change: Added generic proactive-message provider window/template rule and PROVIDER-PROACTIVE-TEMPLATE-001.
Added generic proactive provider eligibility control; generic contract test covers two synthetic transfer surfaces.
